## Scope

- [ ] The Workspace objective, included scope, and exclusions are clear.
- [ ] Forge peer, Engineering Platform, TDE, and generic-contract boundaries remain intact.

## Validation and security

- [ ] `bash scripts/validate.sh` passes.
- [ ] Actual tests/build/lint status is recorded; nonexistent checks are not claimed.
- [ ] TDE status is recorded as applicable, observe-only, or not yet established.
- [ ] Security and dependency impact is assessed.

## Documentation and operations

- [ ] Architecture, roadmap, and handoff/provenance impacts are recorded.
- [ ] Production action is stated explicitly, including `NONE` when applicable.
